schemes.Name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
schemes.Description: Financial assistance scheme to encourage female students from Tamil Nadu Government schools to pursue higher education without financial constraints.
Benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 directly credited to the student's bank account.
Coverage extends across Degree, Diploma, ITI, and professional courses until completion.
Reduces financial barriers and higher education dropout rates for women.

Eligibility.School Education: Must have studied Class 6 to Class 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
Eligibility.Course Enrollment: Enrolled in undergraduate degree, diploma, ITI, or professional course

Documents: College Admission Fee Receipt & Student ID Card
schemes.Application Process: Students can apply online via the official Pudhumai Penn (Penkalvi) portal or through designated nodal officers in their respective colleges.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme (Chief Minister's Higher Education Assistance for Boys)
schemes.Description: Financial assistance scheme providing ₹1,000 per month to male students from Tamil Nadu Government schools pursuing higher education.
Benefits: Monthly financial stipend of ₹1,000 directly deposited via DBT into student bank accounts.
Covers undergraduate degrees, engineering, polytechnic diplomas, ITI, and medical courses.
Encourages higher education enrollment among young men from low-income rural and urban backgrounds.

Eligibility.School Education: Must have studied Class 6 to Class 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
Eligibility.Course Enrollment: Enrolled in Higher Education (Degree / Diploma / ITI / Engineering / Medicine)

schemes.Application Process: Apply online through college nodal officers or the official Tamil Nadu Higher Education Portal.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Naan Mudhalvan Skill Development Scheme
schemes.Description: Comprehensive skill enhancement and career guidance initiative for both male and female college students and youth across Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Free industry-aligned training in AI, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Web Development, Robotics, and Communication Skills.
Free certification courses from top global industry leaders (Coursera, Infosys Springboard, Microsoft, IBM).
Direct placement drives, resume building, and corporate internship connections.

Eligibility.Target Group: School and College Students (Arts, Science, Engineering, Polytechnic, ITI) & Unemployed Youth

schemes.Application Process: Students can register online via the official Naan Mudhalvan portal or access courses through their college portal integration.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC) - August 2026

schemes.Name: Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
schemes.Description: State cashless health insurance scheme providing free quality medical and surgical treatment up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for all residents of Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per annum for 1,500+ medical & surgical procedures.
Free treatment in empanelled Government and top Private multi-specialty hospitals.
Covers specialized surgeries, cancer care, organ transplantation, and emergency procedures.

Eligibility.Income Limit: Annual family income below ₹1.20 Lakhs per annum
Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu listed in Smart Ration Card

schemes.Application Process: Apply at the District Kiosk in the District Collectorate or at empanelled government hospitals with Ration Card & Aadhaar.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Health and Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
schemes.Description: Flagship basic income support scheme providing direct financial aid of ₹1,000 per month to eligible women heads of households across Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of ₹1,000 per month into bank accounts.
Provides financial independence and livelihood security to over 1 crore women.
No middleman intervention with transparent digital transfer.

Eligibility.Land Holding: Wetland less than 5 acres or dry land less than 10 acres
Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu with valid Smart Ration Card

Documents: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card (Ration Card)
schemes.Application Process: Applications are collected during special camps conducted at local ration shops/e-Sevai centers across Tamil Nadu.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Special Programme Implementation Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
schemes.Description: Credit-linked capital subsidy scheme encouraging micro-enterprise creation among unemployed male and female youth in Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Project cost support up to ₹15 Lakhs for manufacturing and ₹5 Lakhs for service/business activities.
Government Capital Subsidy of 25% of the project cost (max ₹3.75 Lakhs).
Low promoter contribution (5% for special categories/women/men, 10% for general).

Eligibility.Age: 18 to 45 years (relaxation up to 45 years for women, SC/ST, BC/MBC, Divyangjan)
Eligibility.Family Income: Family income not exceeding ₹5 Lakhs per annum
Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu for minimum 3 years

schemes.Application Process: Apply online through the MSME Online portal (msmeonline.tn.gov.in) and submit hard copies to District Industries Centre (DIC).
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Department of Industries and Commerce, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
schemes.Description: Special capital subsidy and interest subvention scheme promoting educated first-generation entrepreneurs (both male and female) in Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: 25% Capital Subsidy on project cost up to ₹75 Lakhs.
3% Interest Subvention for the entire loan tenure.
Bank loan assistance up to ₹5 Crores for manufacturing and service enterprises.

Eligibility.Age: 18 to 35 years (General), up to 45 years for Women, SC/ST, BC/MBC, Ex-servicemen, Transgender
Eligibility.Educational Qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Vocational Training completion

Documents: Land / Building Lease Deed or Purchase Agreement
schemes.Application Process: Apply online via MSME Tamil Nadu portal and attend District Level Selection Committee (DLSC) interview at DIC.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Tamil Nadu Free Laptop Scheme for Students
schemes.Description: Welfare scheme providing free laptops to male and female students in Government and Government-aided institutions to facilitate digital learning.
Benefits: Free branded laptop preloaded with educational software, operating system, and study tools.
Enables digital learning, online research, and technical skill development for both boys and girls.

Eligibility.Target Group: Students of Class 11 & 12 in Government and Aided Schools, Arts, Science, Polytechnic & Engineering Colleges
Eligibility.Institution: Government and Government-aided schools & colleges in Tamil Nadu

Documents: School / College Roll Number & Student ID Card
schemes.Application Process: No individual application required; eligible male and female students are identified directly through school and college administration lists.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: School Education Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam (Healthcare at Doorstep)
schemes.Description: Flagship healthcare delivery initiative providing doorstep medical screening, hypertension/diabetes medicines, and palliative care for all residents (both men and women).
Benefits: Free doorstep delivery of medicines for hypertension, diabetes, kidney disease, and chronic ailments.
Home-based physiotherapy, palliative care, and dialysis support for elderly and bedridden patients.
Early screening for NCDs (Non-Communicable Diseases) and cervical/breast cancers.

Eligibility.Target Group: All residents of Tamil Nadu, senior citizens, bedridden patients, and chronic disease patients

schemes.Application Process: Health workers (Women Health Volunteers) visit households directly for screening and registration; citizens can also register at local Primary Health Centres (PHCs).
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project, Health and Family Welfare Department - August 2026

schemes.Name: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Mission (TNSDM) Free Vocational Training
schemes.Description: 100% free short-term vocational skill training with monthly stipend and guaranteed placement support for unemployed male and female youth.
Benefits: Free vocational training in IT-ITES, Automotive, Electronics, Healthcare, Hospitality, and Apparel sectors.
Free uniform, learning material, assessment, and placement assistance with certified employers.
Monthly stipend credited during training period.

Eligibility.Qualification: Class 8, 10, 12 pass, ITI, Diploma, or Degree holders

schemes.Application Process: Register online on the TNSDC portal (tnskill.tn.gov.in) or visit nearest Govt ITI / Training Provider Center.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC) - August 2026

schemes.Name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
schemes.Description: Maternal health and financial assistance scheme aimed at providing financial support and nutrition kits to poor pregnant women in Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Total financial assistance of ₹18,000 disbursed in 5 installments.
2 Nutrition Kits valued at ₹4,000 containing health supplements, iron syrup, and nutrition mix.
Ensures institutional delivery and proper antenatal care.

Eligibility.Residency: Resident of Tamil Nadu registered in PICME portal

Documents: PICME (Pregnancy and Infant Cohort Monitoring and Evaluation) RCH ID Card
schemes.Application Process: Register pregnancy within 12 weeks at local Village Health Nurse (VHN) or Urban Health Nurse (UHN) / Primary Health Centre (PHC).
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Health and Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu - August 2026

schemes.Name: Chief Minister’s Breakfast Scheme
schemes.Description: Nutritional welfare initiative supplying free healthy breakfast to male and female primary school children in Government schools across Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: Free hot cooked nutritious breakfast (upma, kichadi, pongal with sambar) served every school day to both boys and girls.
Combats childhood malnutrition, improves classroom attendance, and enhances learning capacity.

Eligibility.Institution: All Government primary and middle schools in Tamil Nadu

schemes.Application Process: Automatically provided to all enrolled Class 1–5 male and female students in Tamil Nadu Government schools.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department - August 2026

schemes.Name: Chief Minister’s Solar Powered Green House Scheme (Solar Green House)
schemes.Description: Provides 100% free solar-powered concrete houses (300 sq ft) for rural BPL families (both men and women heads of households) in Tamil Nadu.
Benefits: 100% subsidy for construction of 300 sq.ft RCC solar-powered green house.
Includes solar home lighting system with 5 LED lights and fan points.
Improves living standards for rural poor, SC/ST families, and disabled citizens.

Eligibility.Target Group: Below Poverty Line (BPL) families living in rural areas of Tamil Nadu
Eligibility.Land Ownership: Must own at least 300 sq.ft of patta land

schemes.Application Process: Apply at Block Development Office (BDO) or Village Panchayat Office.
schemes.Source / Last Updated: Department of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj, Tamil Nadu - August 2026
